messages:
jess: FYI — two enterprise customers just filed support tickets: they can’t figure out why some requests hit the ‘accelerator’ pool and have lower per-route quotas. Console shows a per-route override but not how it combines with account-level caps. Proposing an "Access Preview" panel that shows the computed effective grants (actions allowed), routing affinity, and quota window for a given route + principal. Also: we need an API endpoint and telemetry for preview usage. Thoughts? :eyes:

omkar: +1. We already do a bunch of this in the authz service but it’s scattered. Key perf question: if console calls this live on every hover, we’ll need caching and a low-cost precompute path.

kevin: I like the preview idea. Backend approach suggestion: compute effective access on-demand but cache per (tenant, principal, route, ttl). Add a lightweight endpoint: POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/access_preview {
  "route": "/generate-invoice",
  "principal": "service-account-123",
  "simulate_overrides": true
}
Return shape (summary lines): allowed_actions[], routing_affinity: [pool:score], quota {limit, remaining, reset_ts}, source_breakdown: [account, route, policy].

lia: From product side — will need UX mocks + deterministic wording for "why" decisions (audit trace). Compliance wants an audit_id we can tie to logs. Also: rollout plan — feature flag gated, and add an opt-in telemetry flag for enterprises.

sara: Design notes: keep preview compact — show a single-line summary with an expand chevron. Don’t show raw policy syntax by default. Microcopy suggestion: "Effective access is derived from tenant-level policies and route-specific overrides. Use \u2018View audit trace\u2019 to see the contributing rules." Could be a tooltip. :memo:

kevin: Backend needs: 1) aggregator in authz that merges sources and returns source_breakdown, 2) TTL cache + invalidation on policy change, 3) rate-limit per-console-session. Telemetry events I propose: access_preview.view (when panel opened), access_preview.api_call (for API usage), access_preview.cached (bool). Include audit_id in every response.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag "access_preview" created (default: off). Can roll to 10% canary.

jess: For rollout: start with internal tenants + one friendly customer. We should record feedback on two things: clarity of routing explanation and perceived quota numbers. Owners?

omkar: I can own backend implementation + cache keys. Implementation notes: cache key = sha(tenant + principal + route + policy_version). Need to surface policy_version in response so UI can warn if stale. Also we should add a cheap endpoint to pre-warm cache for a set of routes.

lia: I’ll own product rollout and create the help doc. I’ll coordinate with support for the friendly customer.

kevin: Telemetry schema (proposal): event: "access_preview.view" properties: ["tenant_id","principal_id","route","result_source":"cache|computed","audit_id","latency_ms","preview_mode":"ui|api"]. event: "access_preview.api_call" properties: ["api_client","status_code","cost_estimate_tokens"]. Keep events low-cardinality where possible.

sara: Microcopy tweak: "This preview shows the effective permissions and quota for the selected route. It includes tenant-level policies and route overrides. Use View audit trace to inspect the contributing rules." Short and consistent with existing phrasing.

jess: Next steps: (1) omkar/kevin spike for 1 week to land endpoint + caching, (2) lia + sara mock and microcopy, (3) infra flag + 10% canary, (4) validate with 2 customers, (5) safety rollback plan. tagging @kevin @omkar for action items. :thumbsup:
